content.text:
My family
Repère les deux enfants. / Find the two children.
Who are the other people in their family? Answer in English or French.

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: A family portrait showing two school-age children with their parents and grandparents.
elements.request: An illustrated family portrait with two children, their parents and their grandparents. two school-age children. two adult parents. two older grandparents

content.text: Identify family members using mon père, ma mère, mon frère, ma sœur, mes parents and mes grands-parents, choosing mon, ma or mes to match the French noun.
Describe a family member’s name, age and one personality trait using il/elle s’appelle…, il/elle a… ans and il/elle est…, with correct agreement of gentil/gentille and amusant/amusante.
Write a short description of your own or an imaginary family using j’ai… and je n’ai pas de… to describe siblings, followed by details about one family member’s name, age and personality.
Mon, ma and mes mean “my”. Choose for the French noun, not the speaker.
mon: masculine noun; ma: feminine noun

elements.name: Diagram
elements.alt: Mon père: my father; ma mère: my mother; mon frère: my brother; ma sœur: my sister; mes parents: my parents; mes grands-parents: my grandparents.

content.text: Léa says “my brother”. Which phrase is correct?
Ma sœur s’appelle Léa. Elle a treize ans. Elle est gentille.
s’appelle = is called; a … ans = is … years old

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: A cheerful teenage girl with a friendly smile represents Léa.
elements.request: An imaginary teenage sister smiling. teenage girl. friendly smile

content.text: Écris en français. / Write in French. Use: ma sœur; s’appelle; elle; a; est; gentille. Fourteen = quatorze.

Il est gentil. / He is kind.
Il est amusant. / He is funny.
Use these forms with mon frère or mon père.

Elle est gentille. / She is kind.
Elle est amusante. / She is funny.
Not “Elle est gentil”: gentil → gentille.
Use j’ai to say which siblings you have.
J’ai un frère. / I have a brother.
J’ai une sœur. / I have a sister.
Je n’ai pas de sœur. / I don’t have a sister. Use de, not une.
J’ai un frère. Je n’ai pas de sœur. Mon frère s’appelle Hugo. Il a douze ans. Il est amusant.

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: Two school-age children stand side by side, with one clearly shown as the other child’s brother.
elements.request: An imaginary narrator standing beside their only sibling, a brother. two school-age children. boy beside narrator

content.text: Write that you have one sister and no brother.
Add: your sister is called Zoé; she is thirteen.
Écris cinq phrases. / Write five sentences. Words: j’ai; une sœur; je n’ai pas de; frère; ma sœur; s’appelle; elle; a; treize ans; est; amusant / amusante.
Choose a real or imaginary family. State which siblings you have and one you do not have.
Describe one family member: relationship, name, age and one personality trait.
Stretch: add a second family member with a different trait.
Écris un petit paragraphe. / Write a short paragraph. Support: j’ai…; je n’ai pas de…; mon / ma / mes; il / elle s’appelle…; il / elle a… ans; il / elle est…
